text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, computers can create art, compose music, and even write stories. These tools learn from thousands of examples and then produce something new. However, AI-generated art is different from human creativity. Machines follow patterns and data, while people create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI can help artists and writers find new ideas, but it cannot feel joy, sadness, or surprise. So, is AI truly creative? Perhaps it is better to see AI as a helpful partner rather than a replacement for human imagination.
